rationale: Retain independent full output for two legacy restore identities and the absent-record compatibility control; this formatter suite does not claim to resume real agents.

cases.title: lists the old-client restores the host kept, with the command that resumes each
cases.reason: Two distinct kept records cover pressure/host-cap reasons, known/missing agent and cwd, recorded/missing resume command, refusal timestamp and plural count in independent exact output.

cases.title: prints nothing extra when no restore was kept, or the host predates the record
cases.reason: An older daemon omitting legacyRestores must not append a kept-restore section to the normal no-pause message.

classification: Service-manager command orchestration and real temporary unit/brake files
rationale: Retain all nine declarations and every manager/status/launcher control. Require the exact installed service identity and subsequent manager reload on uninstall; correct a title that claimed an unprovided mounted-AppImage input. Managers are injected, not executed.

cases.title: installs and loads a LaunchAgent, clearing an old give-up
cases.reason: Real temporary LaunchAgent output embeds the executable; launchctl bootout/bootstrap order and actual crash-brake deletion protect reinstall behavior.

cases.title: enables a systemd unit and reports lingering
cases.reason: Linux installation requires daemon-reload, enable and restart in order and reports the injected loginctl Linger=no result.

cases.title: fails loudly when the manager refuses, and writes nothing on a dry run
cases.reason: Dry run leaves the unit absent and invokes no manager; subsequent bootstrap code5/denied must reject.

cases.title: reports live, exited and unverifiable from the manager
cases.reason: Retain launchd running/PID4242, not-found113, no-answer/null and GUI-failure5 plus systemd active/PID99 controls; distinguish exited from unverifiable with injected manager text.

cases.title: uninstalls by stopping the service and removing the unit
cases.reason: Verify removal of the actual installed unit, exact stop target and daemon-reload. A mutant disabling orca-serve-wrong.service passes the original prefix assertion and fails the reviewed exact command list.

cases.title: never picks a version-scoped launcher from the profile or a mounted AppImage
cases.reason: Keep real profile-scoped executable skip and Linux bare-orca refusal; name those actual inputs instead of claiming mounted-AppImage coverage that was absent.

cases.title: refuses Windows and a relative --command
cases.reason: Keep Windows unsupported-manager rejection, relative explicit-command rejection and missing executable PATH rejection.

cases.title: names the command to run when only a server-only orca exists here
cases.reason: Server-only Linux/macOS failure guidance must name the correct app CLI and issue no manager call; stable PATH fallback and explicit stable override still admit dry runs.

cases.title: refuses a --command tied to one Orca version
cases.reason: A real executable inside the active profile is rejected as an explicit version-scoped service command.

classification: Installed-skill projection and local-only publish CLI adapter
rationale: Retain all seven declarations and both remote-environment rows. Replace unchecked HandlerContext fixture with a RuntimeClient plus typed call/getter spies; require the exact flattened public publish summary instead of a token/secret absence check whose input supplied neither.

cases.title: lists safe installed-skill selectors without local paths
cases.reason: Installed discovery passes cwd, preserves a concrete selector and strips concrete root/directory/SKILL.md paths supplied by the runtime fixture.

cases.title: denies publishing at preflight before invoking skills.share
cases.reason: Disabled preflight must produce agent_skill_sharing_disabled after exactly settings.get and before publishing.

cases.title: publishes multiple explicit skills and prints only public output
cases.reason: Repeated explicit skill selectors, bundle name, release notes, cwd and ten-minute timeout reach skills.share. Require the complete independently written public result projection; a leaked version field passes the original assertions but fails this case.

cases.title: normalizes a human-readable bundle name before publishing
cases.reason: Actual name normalization transforms the accented/spaced/doubled-separator label into the expected package slug before publishing.

cases.title: rejects a bundle name that cannot produce a valid package name
cases.reason: A name containing only an emoji cannot normalize to a valid bundle name, producing specific invalid_argument guidance before RPC.

cases.title: rejects %s before any discovery or publish call
cases.reason: Both forwarded-cwd and paired-runtime rows must reject invalid_environment before any settings/discovery/share call; afterEach restores env and spies.

cases.title: gives an actionable upgrade error for an older runtime
cases.reason: An older runtime with absent capability setting reaches the share RPC, whose typed method_not_found refusal becomes update_required.

classification: Piped speech-key ingestion and old-server compatibility errors
rationale: Keep all four declarations and their chunk/TTY/blank/oversize controls. Require incompatible_runtime as well as independent upgrade guidance on the older-server error path.

cases.title: reads the key from piped stdin and trims the trailing newline
cases.reason: A two-buffer async iterable must join the key and trim its trailing newline.

cases.title: refuses an interactive terminal instead of waiting on it
cases.reason: An interactive isTTY input requires actionable pipe guidance instead of reading stdin.

cases.title: refuses empty and oversized input
cases.reason: Whitespace-only stdin and a1025-character key reject with distinct blank/oversize guidance; no early streaming-byte-limit coverage is claimed.

cases.title: names the update instead of surfacing method_not_found
cases.reason: A method_not_found refusal must become incompatible_runtime plus upgrade guidance. Changing only the mapped code to invalid_argument passes the original message-only test and fails this reviewed assertion.
